Name: ChefRudes More Interesting Menagerie for Content Patcher
Author: chefrude
Description:
[size=6][center]Make your Farm Animal Menagerie More Interesting![/center][/size]﻿This Content Patcher mod allows you to [s]replace the vanilla[/s] [b]add new animals and livestock[/b] from the "Wandering Ones" mega-mod to the livestock and animal shop. These include:

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mTgCuJA.png[/img]﻿﻿ [img]https://i.imgur.com/kRxyKIN.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/QEvEIyo.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DZuFdq3.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/t52UR7B.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/t1Tf38N.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WrCmcRx.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/RS120Ia.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/LvB70Z6.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2PfJ8sK.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/5GZ3kro.png[/img][/center]


[size=5]To Install
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ installed[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the CP ChefRudes More Interesting Managerie file, and unpack it[/size]
[*][size=3]Drag it to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Credit
[/size][size=3]This mod was updated by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/10252540]silvermoonchan [/url]who updated it to work with the new CP code.[/size]
